compiled_state.title: As a sprint orchestrator, I want the inline per-task iteration loop to route findings by attribution class and gate closure on intent_match, so pixel-observable defects get fixed or annotated as visual debt
compiled_state.author: Test

comments.body:
## Description

**What**: Wire the visual-evaluator into task-execution.md as an inline per-task iteration loop that routes findings by attribution_class and gates closure on intent_match.

**Scope**:
- IN: task-execution.md updated with visual-evaluator invocation post-implementation
- IN: Attribution routing logic, iteration cap, visual_debt annotation
- IN: Config keys: visual_evaluator.iteration_cap (default 2), visual_evaluator.iteration_threshold (default 3)
- IN: Surfaces visual_eval_inapplicable:route_map_stale prominently when raised by skill
- OUT: Dogfood replay (draft-4-dogfood), post-batch dispatch (draft-5a)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, task-execution.md invokes visual-evaluator after sub-agent implementation and routes by attribution_class: implementation_drift → re-prompt; design_flaw → re-dispatch ui-designer; mixed|uncertain|low-confidence → user dialog (or INTERACTIVITY_DEFERRED in non-interactive mode)
  <- Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, iteration_cap=2 and intent_match threshold=3 (both configurable) are honored; iteration cap and review.max_cycles are documented as independent counters with interaction contract
  <- Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, intent_match below threshold blocks task closure; quality-dim-only shortfalls annotate visual_debt:<dimension> and proceed
  <- Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, visual_eval_inapplicable:route_map_stale surfaced prominently (not silently swallowed) when skill emits it
  <- Satisfies: sc-2 (via sc-4 integration)
- When this story is complete, regression tests: (a) sustained intent_match drift fails closure after 2 iterations; (b) quality-dim-only shortfall closes with visual_debt annotation; (c) mixed/uncertain findings trigger auto-defer after 2nd user-dialog escalation
  <- Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Integration] iteration_cap=2 governs visual self-correction only; review.max_cycles governs text-review autonomous-resolution — document both as independent counters; visual iteration runs first

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue. Escalate only when genuinely blocked. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
